Job Details: 

Title: RF Antenna Test Engineer

Location: Newark, CA 94560

Duration: 06 months of contract to hire | Onsite  

Pay Range: $70/Hr. to $75/Hr.  

Benefits: 

The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, life insurance, long-term disability insurance, short-term disability insurance, paid parking/public transportation, (paid time , paid sick and safe time , hours of paid vacation time, weeks of paid parental leave, paid holidays annually - AS Applicable) 

 

Job Description: 

  • Perform hands-on RF, antenna, and wireless validation testing across infotainment, telematics, radio, and other vehicle wireless systems.
  • Troubleshoot RF hardware issues and perform root-cause analysis at the device/unit level.
  • Conduct RF OTA and conducted testing, antenna characterization, and performance validation.
  • Use lab equipment including VNA, spectrum analyzer, power meter, LitePoint, CMW500/CMX500, and related RF test equipment.
  • Analyze RF performance including S-parameters, impedance matching, signal performance, and de-sense/interference.
  • Work with engineering teams and external labs to resolve issues and ensure wireless performance requirements are met

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on RF testing, validation, or hardware engineering experience.
  • Strong experience with RF/antenna testing and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with VNA, spectrum analyzers, RF communication testers, and RF lab equipment.
  • Experience with CST, HFSS, or similar RF simulation tools.
  • Automotive, mobile device, telecommunications, or consumer electronics experience is highly relevant.

 

 

 

Job Requirement
  • RF testing
  • Wireless Validation
  • RF Hardware
